description: This file defines the Country class within the OpenCart admin module, responsible for managing country data, including listing, information retrieval, file generation, and cleanup tasks.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: A controller class for managing country data and related tasks in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes country tasks by clearing old data and setting up new tasks for listing countries.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves the list of countries, generates a JSON file with country data, and schedules info tasks.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Generates detailed JSON file for a specific country, including description and zones, based on provided country_id.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes the generated country JSON files from the local filesystem.
